name: Image Tube Gallery
description: Full-screen 3D gallery where image tiles wrap rotating cylindrical rows over a warped grid backdrop. Wheel input spins and scrolls the tube, hover slows it and shows a label.
contents: Rows of image tiles arranged around a 3D cylinder
Animated shader grid backdrop that bulges toward the pointer
Hover tooltip with image label and custom cursor dot
behavior: Rows rotate continuously at different speeds
Mouse wheel adds spin and vertical scroll with inertia and endless looping
Hovering a tile slows rotation and shows a following tooltip
Grid backdrop distorts around the pointer and screen edges
Custom circular cursor follows the pointer with easing
editableByProps: Images, labels and tile count and size
Tube radius, row count, spacing, speed and camera
Grid backdrop colors, scale and visibility
Tooltip and custom cursor toggles, background class

needsCodeEdit.change: Change grid warp strength and radius

fixed: Root is fixed to the full viewport and captures wheel input, so it covers the page
Hides the native cursor over the gallery
Includes a drei Loader progress overlay while textures load
Wheel events drive the spin, page scrolling is not used
